joints.handle_description: No handle; glossy bowl-shaped porthole door 127 mm thick, bezel protrudes ~2 cm but leaf edge has no clearance behind; X bumps are bezel facets

object_note: Door hinged on -y (viewer-left) swinging to +y. Eleven X markers are flush bezel facets, not handles; F is buried in the bezel. Only a radial rim pinch could work.
